sloka: तं वानराः प्रेक्ष्य विनेदुरुच्चैः स तानपि प्रेक्ष्य मुदा ननाद।तेषां समुद्घुष्टरवं निशम्य लङ्कालया भीमतरं विनेदुः ।। ६.७४.७१ ।।
transliteration: taṁ vānarāḥ prekṣya vineduruccaiḥ sa tānapi prekṣya mudā nanāda।teṣāṁ samudghuṣṭaravaṁ niśamya laṅkālayā bhīmataraṁ vineduḥ ।। 6.74.71 ।।

translations.english: The great Hanuman along with the mountain descended in the midst of the Vanara army, and greeted the army head bent down and embraced Vibheeshana standing there.
